Pin: two rules both matching the same trigger fire in source-declaration order. NOTE: both match on ONE propagation, so source order and completion order COINCIDE here and either model passes — this fixture cannot tell them apart. It refuses an order that is neither (a hash or a reversal). LDET.5.4.completion.json is the one that can.
